display_name: 有界身份指导的源域理想信息诊断
description: 先固定盲父模型的源域 IQ 和预测，再用合法 L_s 真值与冻结基座梯度，在限定波形改变量下测量分类可修复性。
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU2 fixed source baseline then L_s true-label optimization, CPU 2 threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: IQ [2,256], 910 impaired L_s source records; fixed parent IQ then deliberate per-record source label oracle
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: L_s source true labels intentionally used for per-record oracle only after baseline fixed; no U_s truth, V or test
data.validation_ref: 613 RX4/6 plus 297 RX8 impaired L_s source role, previously explored in other source views

permissions.query_use: Source-only deliberate L_s label oracle and paired source IQ after baseline hash fixed; no U_s truth, V, test or target IQ
permissions.claim_scope: True label oracle is non-deployable; source IDs seen by F; perturbations may exploit F; no accuracy or satellite claim

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen blind action model, source Gaussian prior, input gate .8 and Tri-SIG-TIME SSL; source labels used only for bounded oracle diagnostic; DURA source comparator.
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: No model selection. Fix and hash all 910 source parent IQ/predictions before L_s truth. Optimize with fixed relative L2 bounds .02,.05,.10 and 16 steps; oracle truth not deployable.

execution.launch_owner: Codex bounded L_s identity oracle source GPU2 owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU2 only after independent idle check; real source pseudo-label smoke; predictions fixed before L_s truth

execution.stop_rule: Stop for source provenance/role violations, output collision, nonfinite values or technical failures; do not retry without state reconciliation.

metrics_plan.scientific_rule: Oracle deliberately uses true L_s source labels; not deployable and not a general performance upper bound; small-norm perturbation may exploit classifier.

rows.method: fixed blind parent plus per-record frozen-F gradient optimization under L2 waveform bound, true L_s label oracle
rows.purpose: assess local classifier correction potential and waveform distortion before designing label-free candidate inference
rows.seed_notes: prior sample same as fixed estimator; source split 2026110551; no additional model updates
rows.scenario: source clean and six simulated impaired scenes
rows.optimizer: per-input projected normalized gradient (oracle; no weight updates)
rows.budget_ref: 910 impaired source L_s records, 16 gradient steps, three fixed relative L2 radii

notes: True source device label intentionally used during oracle; cannot be used at deployment.
Parents and IQ hashed before source truth; no U_s labels, V, or Phase1 test.
Small L2 waveform change can be adversarial and does not prove physically valid restoration.
F trained on source L_s IDs; source physical IDs previously explored.
